messages:
Kai Liao: Quick sync — Ashby proposed a joint perf/W validation on their new E-Edge board next week. We need kernel micropatch plan, workload list, and a telemetry contract. Thoughts? :eyes:
Maya Patel: +1. Can we scope to single-seq and batched-4 workloads? Keep it small for an initial pass and clear telemetry.
Tomás Rivera: I can own the kernel changes. Need test vectors and target quant configs. What's the model suite? llama-2-7b, mpt-7b, and a rerank flow ok?
Evelyn (Ashby): Yep those models look representative. We'll run 3 E-Edge boards in parallel. We'll provide SSH access, perf counters, and a power meter feed. Need your KV caching hooks enabled.
Kai Liao: Telemetry ask: per-token latency, GPU power (W), thermal events, kernel patch SHA, and p99/p50 breakdown. Preferred export: CSV + Prometheus scrape. Is that doable?
Evelyn (Ashby): Scrape is fine. We'll expose node_exporter + custom metrics. We'll also stream the power-meter CSVs. We'll share a Docker image and a small run script:
```
./runbench.sh --suite combined --seq 1024 --batch 4 --out /tmp/results.csv
```
Tomás Rivera: Draft kernel patch will be a tiny prefetch for KV cache lines, no ABI changes. I'll open a PR against infra/kernel by EOD and tag reviewers.
Maya Patel: On Redwood side I'll prepare a dedicated job profile (2xA100 equiv), the eval prompt set, and baseline scripts. Also will enable canary routing to an MPT-3B-FT fallback if we hit OOMs.
DevBot: deploy-kit: created job template `ashby/edge/throughput-power/v1` — https://redwood.internal/deploy/ashby (internal link).
Jordan (marketing): Heads-up — marketing wants an embargoed joint blog + datasheet. Can we target results + draft assets in 3 weeks? I can own the announcement timeline.
Kai Liao: Proposed timeline: kernel PR today, Ashby run Wed-Thu, telemetry ingest + analysis Fri, draft results next week. Monday 10am PT sync to confirm smoke run. Any blockers?
Evelyn (Ashby): One ask from our legal: short NDA addendum specifying telemetry columns and embargo window. I'll email legal contact and copy Kai + Jordan.
Maya Patel: I'll create the eval prompts and upload baseline artifacts to gs://redwood-partner/ashby/perf-watt/ once ready.
Tomás Rivera: PR posted: infra/kernel/kv-prefetch — reviewers @maria @mike. Please review when you can.
Kai Liao: Awesome — thanks everyone. See you at Monday 10am PT. :rocket:
